# scm_dlp_data_filtering_profile (Data Source)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] DLP Data Filtering Profile data source (`/v2/api/data-filtering-profiles/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a DLP data filtering profile by its ID.
data "scm_dlp_data_filtering_profile" "example" {
  id = "REPLACE_WITH_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the data filtering profile.

### Read-Only

- `app_exclusion_list` (Attributes List) List of application exclusions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--app_exclusion_list))
- `data_profile_id` (Number) The ID of the parent data profile.
- `description` (String) Description of the data filtering profile.
- `direction` (String) Scan direction.
- `euc_template_id` (String) End User Coaching template ID.
- `exception_rules` (Attributes List) List of exception rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exception_rules))
- `file_based` (Boolean) Whether file-based scanning is active.
- `file_type` (List of String) List of file types.
- `is_end_user_coaching_enabled` (Boolean) Whether End User Coaching is enabled.
- `log_severity` (String) Log severity.
- `name` (String) The name of the data filtering profile.
- `non_file_based` (Boolean) Whether non-file-based scanning is active.
- `rule1_action` (String) Action for rule 1.
- `rule2_action` (String) Action for rule 2.
- `scan_type` (String) Scan type.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `url_exclusion_list` (Attributes List) List of URL exclusions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--url_exclusion_list))

<a id="nestedatt--app_exclusion_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `app_exclusion_list`

Read-Only:

- `app_id` (String) Application ID.
- `app_name` (String) Application name.
- `type` (String) Application type.


<a id="nestedatt--exception_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exception_rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Exception rule action.
- `log_severity` (String) Exception rule log severity.
- `name` (String) Exception rule name.


<a id="nestedatt--url_exclusion_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `url_exclusion_list`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) URL type.
- `url_id` (String) URL ID.
- `url_name` (String) URL pattern or name.
